projects.title: A bowling day out for the Sivapoomi kids
projects.summary: We are arranging a day at the bowling lanes for the special-needs children of Sivapoomi: a day out to play, laugh and be cheered on.
projects.story:
## The idea

We want to take the special-needs children of Sivapoomi out for a bowling day. A day away from the usual routine, where every child gets a turn on the lane, every roll gets a cheer, and everyone goes home smiling.

## Where we are now

The project has been **initiated**. We have requested the budget for the day and are waiting for a response.

## What happens next

- The budget is approved
- We fix the date and book the lanes
- We arrange transport, food and helpers for the day
- The kids go bowling

## How you can help

We will need extra hands on the day to help the children at the lanes and to keep the cheering loud. If you would like to join, [volunteer with us](/volunteer).

projects.title: An arcade trip for the orphanage kids
projects.summary: We are planning a trip to the arcade for children from an orphanage: games, lights, prizes and a day made just for them.
projects.story:
## The idea

We want to take children from an orphanage out to the arcade. A few hours of games, bright lights and little prizes, where the only thing they have to do is have fun.

## Where we are now

The project has been **initiated**. We are waiting for the budget and for the other details of the trip to be confirmed.

## What happens next

- The budget and the details are confirmed
- We fix the date and book the arcade
- We arrange transport, food and helpers for the day
- The kids take over the games

## How you can help

We will need extra hands on the day to look after the children and cheer on every high score. If you would like to join, [volunteer with us](/volunteer).
